lines.trans: Everyone down! Special forces at work!
What is happening here? Who are you?
Everyone down on the floor, I said!
Drop weapons! Hands behind head!
We are doing nothing bad!
Nobody move from this spot!
Please do not shoot, we surrender!
Stay in place and keep quiet!
A big mistake has occurred here.
There is no mistake, you are under arrest!
